method.statistics: Across-run distributions; frame/tick p95 and max computed within each run before comparison. Positive improvement_percent means less work/time/RSS.
method.acceptance: >=5% median improvement and >=80% paired direction, or non-overlapping distributions; no guard regression beyond noise; correctness passes. Smaller real wins require simpler code.
method.gc_measurement: GC.total_time per-update/tick deltas include all GUI threads; not individual STW pauses.
method.cache: Warm/uncontrolled; separate DONTNEED asset-page advice does not establish a cold OS/runtime cache.

scenarios.launch: Real native Quick Battle, seed 517a27ed; menu/battle paint barriers; 2 s early updates. Separate resume, audio/windowed, advisory cold-assets pairs.
scenarios.gc_gui: Unprofiled 18 s windowed/audio combat with movement and banana shot.
scenarios.host: Three seeded 6-team/36-grub bot matches, 1800 ticks each, JSON snapshot/tick and checkpoint/60 ticks; excludes socket I/O/fsync.
scenarios.frame: Existing deterministic 36-grub/60-flame FrameProfile fixture and unprofiled windowed/audio rendering journey.
scenarios.terrain: 48 maps/run: four sizes x four biomes x three shapes; correctness repeats ten seeds (480 maps).
scenarios.memory: 600 active seconds each for baseline and rejected deferred-import prototype, completed matches/rematches, cooperative <=125 s exclusive leases; no cadence conclusions.

experiments.hypothesis: Avoid loading unused host Reactor code in the GUI.
experiments.change: Remove one redundant require; retain eager networking and certificate imports.
experiments.reason: Fresh require CPU improves 6.08% (5/5), resume require CPU 6.11% (4/5), and removing a redundant import simplifies boot. However resume frame CPU p95 rises 13.86% (4/5 worse), maximum rises 45.02% (5/5 worse), and observed GC work rises; fresh median frame CPU also rises 5.75% (4/5 worse). No guard regression is permitted, so the one-line prototype is not retained.

experiments.hypothesis: Avoid menu-only loading of sockets, TLS and host Reactor.
experiments.change: Autoload Connection/Certificate, require URI and Protocol explicitly, remove eager Reactor require.
experiments.reason: Fresh warm menu improves 6.79% (5/5), resumed menu 7.33%, cold-assets menu 8.26%, and menu RSS falls about 25%. However early GC work rises 6.04→13.69 ms warm and 4.37→13.07 ms cold, with disjoint total-GC distributions; cold CPU p95 rises 17.48% (4/5 worse), early CPU maxima rise about 92–94%. Shifting work past launch fails the frame/GC guard even though cadence intervals stay similar.

experiments.hypothesis: YJIT reduces GUI frame and host tick CPU without startup/spike/RSS regressions.
experiments.reason: Five startup pairs fail launch, early frame p95/max, GUI RSS and GC guards despite faster match preparation. Five host pairs improve mean CPU 17.45% and p95 31.01%, but RSS rises 8.47% and maximum tick CPU rises 12.67%, both worse in all pairs. These guard failures reject global and host-only enablement for this workload; no Mac runtime rebuild is justified. Unprofiled live combat median CPU improves 25.27%, but maximum update CPU rises 12.78→28.30 ms (5/5 worse; maximum distributions disjoint), independently confirming the spike guard failure.

experiments.reason: Five paired host captures: CPU mean improves only 0.126%, 3/5 direction, overlapping distributions; RSS is not reduced. Code region about 1.52 MB plus about 3.52 MB YJIT allocation never approaches either cap; code GC count is zero.

experiments.reason: Five paired map batches: CPU mean improves only 0.97% with overlapping distributions, despite deterministic 4.23% fewer allocations. No primary timing win beyond noise, so the simplification exception is not used.
